name: Threshold Mask
description: Masks pixels with intensity outside a configurable range. Useful for removing hot pixels, dead pixels, or saturated detector regions.

above_enabled.label: Mask above
above_enabled.description: Enable masking of pixels with intensity above the upper threshold.

above_value.label: Upper threshold
above_value.description: Pixels with intensity above this value will be masked.

below_enabled.label: Mask below
below_enabled.description: Enable masking of pixels with intensity below the lower threshold.

below_value.label: Lower threshold
below_value.description: Pixels with intensity below this value will be masked.

name: Cosmic Ray Mask
description: Detects cosmic ray artifacts by comparing each pixel's intensity to local statistics (mean and standard deviation) in a sliding window. Pixels significantly brighter than their neighborhood are flagged. Runs iteratively to catch fainter artifacts revealed after removing bright ones.

sigma.label: Sigma
sigma.description: Number of standard deviations above the local mean for a pixel to be flagged as a cosmic ray. Higher values are more conservative.

window_size.label: Window size
window_size.description: Size of the local neighborhood window (in pixels) used to calculate mean and standard deviation. Should be odd.

iterations.label: Iterations
iterations.description: Number of detection passes. Each pass removes found cosmic rays before the next, catching fainter artifacts revealed by removal of bright ones.

min_intensity.label: Min intensity
min_intensity.description: Minimum absolute pixel intensity to consider as a cosmic ray. Pixels below this value are never flagged, regardless of their local z-score.

name: Spot Mask
description: Masks single-crystal spots and intensity outliers in powder diffraction images by binning pixels by 2-theta and flagging those that deviate significantly from the bin mean. Requires calibration geometry.

method.label: Method
method.description: Statistical method for outlier detection. 'median' uses median + k×MAD (robust, recommended). 'mean' uses mean + k×std (faster but less sensitive).

esdmul.label: Sigma multiplier
esdmul.description: Number of standard deviations (or MADs) above the bin center for a pixel to be flagged as an outlier. Lower values mask more aggressively.

num_bins.label: Number of 2θ bins
num_bins.description: Number of angular bins to divide the 2-theta range into. More bins give finer angular resolution but fewer pixels per bin for statistics.

iterations.label: Iterations
iterations.description: Number of sigma-clipping iterations. More iterations improve robustness when many outliers are present in a bin, but each iteration roughly doubles computation time. Only used with Python fallback (C extension always uses single pass).

smooth_sigma.label: Smooth sigma (px)
smooth_sigma.description: Gaussian smoothing sigma applied to the raw binary mask before thresholding. Merges nearby flagged pixels into coherent spot regions. Set to 0 to disable smoothing.

smooth_threshold.label: Smooth threshold
smooth_threshold.description: Threshold applied after Gaussian smoothing. Pixels with smoothed values above this are included in the final mask. Lower values expand masked regions.
